The bounded canonical kernel controls lower-order terms, and finite-rank approximation/triangular CLT jointly realizes second and first Wiener chaoses. Product formula Cov(I2(K)^2,I1(g)^2)=8||Kg||² confirms same constant, proving dependence despite zero covariance.
